New 
One-click invoicing to QuickBooks Online
› 



Stop re-typing invoices. Send client invoices straight from your schedule into
QuickBooks Online in one click. Every shift worked becomes an invoice line automatically, with
customers, service items, invoice numbers, terms and sales tax handled for you. Work that used to
take days of manual transfer each month now takes minutes.


See It in a Live Demo 













Blended Security ManagementTM

The Future of Security Isn’t More Guards. It’s Better-Enabled Guards.


Manage officers, drones, robots, AI monitoring tools, scheduling,

and invoicing from a single platform.



Expand coverage, reduce labor constraints, and create new revenue opportunities through
technology-enabled security operations.



Schedule a Demo 
Watch 3-Minute Overview 
See Pricing 



Built by senior IT professionals and designed with decades of military and private security
experience.















Today’s Security Challenges


- Labor shortages continue to impact growth

- Rising labor costs reduce profitability

- AI and robotics are entering the market rapidly

- Most companies lack a strategy for managing blended operations




Labor Shortages

Finding and retaining qualified security officers is becoming increasingly difficult.



Operational Complexity


Managing schedules, personnel, client sites, and technology from multiple systems wastes
time.




Missed Revenue Opportunities


Many companies lack the tools to offer modern security services powered by AI and
autonomous systems.






SecurityAssignments brings people, technology, and operations together in one system.









Create More Coverage with the Same Workforce

The Future of Security is Human + AI


A trained officer supported by drones, robotics, and AI monitoring can oversee larger areas,
respond faster, and deliver more value than traditional staffing models.



One highly skilled officer can oversee multiple technology assets, expanding coverage,
increasing response capabilities, and reducing operational costs. Blended Security
ManagementTM helps security companies deploy and manage both personnel and technology
assets.









One Platform for Every Security Asset



Personnel

Security Officers, Supervisors, Dispatchers



Drone Systems

Autonomous Patrol, Aerial Response, Site Surveillance



Robotics

Ground Patrol Robots, Access Monitoring



AI Monitoring

Video Analytics, Threat Detection, Virtual Guarding











From Workforce Management To Security Operations Management


- Schedule Personnel

- Track Hard Assets

- Manage Drones

- Monitor Robotics

- Automate Invoicing

- Enable AI Operations


All within a single operational platform.








What Blended Security ManagementTM Delivers


- Eliminate black shifts

- Automate officer communications

- Manage hard security assets

- Track drones and robotic patrol units

- Integrate AI-powered monitoring

- Generate QuickBooks invoices automatically

- Increase coverage without proportional labor growth

- Create new security service offerings









Core Platform Features



1. Mistake-Proof Scheduling


Five automated assignment methods. Smart conflict detection. Overtime controls. Instant
guard confirmations.


No more spreadsheet chaos.



2. Automated License & Qualification Enforcement


Assignments are validated against guard credentials before deployment. If a
qualification doesn’t match — it doesn’t schedule.


Compliance built in.



3. Multi-Channel Guard Notifications

Notify officers instantly via SMS, email, and mobile app.

Track confirmations in real time.



4. Onsite Check-In & Reporting

Geofenced clock-in and clock-out. Real-time incident reporting. Full audit trail.

Protect your company with documented proof.



5. Automated Invoicing & Reporting


Generate invoices automatically based on completed assignments. Export detailed reports
instantly.


New: one-click invoice posting to QuickBooks Online.

We didn’t build a generic scheduling tool.

Powered by Industry and Technology Expertise


In partnership with *consulting partner to be announced soon*, SecurityAssignments helps

Why Security Firms Choose Us

Simple Pricing. Pay for the Hours Your Agents Work.

SecurityAssignments includes scheduling, the Assignment API and the mobile apps, with
cloud hosting, backups, built-in security monitoring and real human support.

Schedule a Demo
See How We Compare

What’s Included

- Cloud-based hosting by dedicated hosting specialists

- Backup services for standard operations

- Multiple levels of security protection, built in from the ground up and under constant monitoring

- Human customer support and training dedicated to resolving 100% of any issue or question

- One-on-one help through setup, as much as you need

- Client, personnel and assignment data in a single source of truth
